FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG ORCASLICER_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=OrcaSlicer \
    SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/orcaslicer-logo.png && \
  echo "**** add mozilla apt repo ****" && \
  install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings && \
  curl -o \
    /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc -L \
    https://packages.mozilla.org/apt/repo-signing-key.gpg && \
  echo \
    "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc] https://packages.mozilla.org/apt mozilla main" > \
    /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mozilla.list && \
  printf \
    "Package: *\nPin: origin packages.mozilla.org\nPin-Priority: 1000\n" > \
    /etc/apt/preferences.d/mozilla && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
    firefox \
    gstreamer1.0-alsa \
    gstreamer1.0-gl \
    gstreamer1.0-gtk3 \
    gstreamer1.0-libav \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-base \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-good \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-ugly \
    gstreamer1.0-pulseaudio \
    gstreamer1.0-qt5 \
    gstreamer1.0-tools \
    gstreamer1.0-x \
    libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0 \
    libmspack0 \
    libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 \
    libwx-perl && \
  echo "**** install orcaslicer from appimage ****" && \
  if [ -z ${ORCASLICER_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    ORCASLICER_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/tags/${ORCASLICER_VERSION}" && \
  DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sX GET "${RELEASE_URL}" | jq -r 'first(.assets[].browser_download_url | select(test("Ubuntu2404_V")))') && \
  cd /tmp && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/orca.app -L \
    "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" && \
  chmod +x /tmp/orca.app && \
  ./orca.app --appimage-extract && \
  mv squashfs-root /opt/orcaslicer && \
  localedef -i en_GB -f UTF-8 en_GB.UTF-8 && \
  chmod +x /opt/orcaslicer/libexec/orca-slicer-env && \
  sed -i "1a export GDK_BACKEND=x11" /opt/orcaslicer/AppRun && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /config/.launchpadlib \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream: # What's Changed This is the OrcaSlicer V2.5.3 release, a maintenance update on top of 2.5.2. Thank you to everyone who reported problems with 2.5.2! It fixes crashes on the Calibration tab, in the Move gizmo and when slicing after a printer switch, and a G-code export that could hang with **Staggered inner seams**. Assemblies with one large flat part among many small ones slice quickly again instead of taking half an hour or more, and Bambu Lab print time estimates with **Arc fitting** on are accurate again. Viewing a G-code file no longer sets the flush multiplier to 1, which made every later multicolor print purge several times as much. The **Prusa MK4S MMU3** and the **Anycubic Kobra 3 Max V2** have profiles, and the Flashforge Creator 5 and 5 Pro can run their firmware's flow calibration before a print. **If you print on an IDEX or IQEX printer**, tools are now numbered from T1, like the filaments in the sidebar, and **Tool 0 Position** is renamed **Tool 1 Position**. See **Interface Fixes** below. ## Downloads | Platform | File | | --- | --- | | Windows installer (x64) | Improvements * **Flow calibration for the Flashforge Creator 5 and 5 Pro** by @ghzserg in [17237](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17237) The send dialog has a Flow calibration checkbox for those two printers, which support it in firmware. It is off by default, so a print behaves exactly as before unless you tick it. # 🛠️ Bug Fixes ## Crashes & Hangs * **No crash on the Calibration tab with a multi-nozzle printer** by @raistlin7447 in [17817](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17817) With printer agents on and a printer such as the Snapmaker U1 connected, opening the Calibration tab crashed OrcaSlicer within seconds on Linux and the Flatpak. Fixes #17802. * **No crash selecting several instances of one object with the Move gizmo** by @kisslorand in [17642](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17642) With the Move gizmo in Object coordinates, selecting several instances of the same object, by clicking them or with Ctrl+A, crashed OrcaSlicer. The gizmo now uses the first instance's orientation, as it already did when no single object was selected. * **No crash slicing after a printer switch leaves fewer filaments** by @raistlin7447 in [17774](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17774) With **Remember printer configuration** on, opening a six-filament project and switching to a printer set up for four crashed the slice on the Flatpak and the AppImage. Fixes #17562. * **No hang exporting G-code with Staggered inner seams on a sharp corner** by @HanifKoh in [17731](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17731) With **Staggered inner seams** on, a model with a hairpin corner, where a wall doubles back on itself, could leave G-code export running forever on one layer and the interface unresponsive. Fixes #17707. * **No crash slicing some projects with adaptive layer height** by @thelegendtubaguy in [17592](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17592) Slicing could run out of stack and crash on a project using unsmoothed adaptive layer heights. Models that did not hit this slice exactly as before. Fixes #17584. ## Slicing & Print Quality * **Viewing a G-code file keeps the flush multiplier** by @SoftFever in [97d9881](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/commit/97d9881a50a4bc7d00442d5e52bef8a53483dc71) Since 2.5.0, opening a .gcode file to view it set the flush multiplier to 1, whatever the file was sliced with. The 1 stayed through a new project, a preset switch and a restart, so every later multicolor slice purged several times as much. The project now keeps the file's own multiplier, and the preview still shows the purge volumes the file was sliced with. * **Assemblies with one large part slice quickly again** by @hammams in [17967](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17967) Since 2.5.0, slicing an assembly with one large flat part among many small ones, such as a sheet with thousands of holes, took 30 minutes or more. It is quick again, and the G-code is unchanged. Fixes #17966. * **A lift on top surfaces only ignores the first travel** by @HanifKoh in [17949](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17949) With **On surfaces** set to **Top Only** or **Top and Bottom**, the travels before the first top surface lifted or stayed flat depending on what was left in memory, so one project could slice differently from one run to the next. Those travels no longer lift. A printer left at the default, **All Surfaces**, is unchanged. * **Embossed text stays on every copy in Bambu Studio projects** by @KuzuriAo in [17942](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17942) — text shared by rotated or scaled copies of an object in a Bambu Studio project loads on the model instead of floating off it. * **Multicolor copies slice in Print by object** by @Noisyfox in [17918](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17918) With **Print sequence** set to **By object**, slicing two printable copies of one multicolor object stopped with a wipe tower generation error, because the slicer kept the shared prime tower enabled after Prepare had already hidden it. The copies now slice without a tower, and a plate with a single copy is unchanged. | Before | After | |--------|-------| | | | * **Travel back to the wipe tower starts from where the head is** by @HanifKoh in [17930](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17930) After a filament change on a Bambu Lab or Qidi printer, the route back around the tower could start from a leftover position, so it cut across the tower or took the long way, and the same project could give different G-code each time you sliced it. Prints on other printers, and with **Skip points** off, are unchanged. * **Bambu Lab print time estimates are accurate again with Arc fitting on** by @thelegendtubaguy in [17591](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17591) On a Bambu Lab printer with **Arc fitting** on, the estimate ran hours over, worst with gyroid infill. A 15% gyroid cube on an X1C was estimated at 8h41m and printed in about 6h21m; it now estimates 6h30m. The estimate has been wrong since 2.3.2. Your G-code and your prints are unchanged. Fixes #17564. * **Spiral vase works on a model painted with one filament** by @gazi-faysal-jubayer in [17073](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17073) — on a multi-nozzle printer, a model painted all over with one filament other than the first was refused with a spiral vase error. Fixes #17072. * **A single-extruder multi-material print keeps the slicer's nozzle temperature** by @oliverzein in [14763](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/14763) On a printer that changes filament through one nozzle, such as a Creality K2 with CFS, the firmware's own temperature won over the one in your filament preset. The tool change now comes before the filament's start G-code, the way it already did on multi-nozzle printers. Fixes #14753. * **Custom G-codes and the wipe tower follow a plate that is moved** by @yw4z in [17569](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17569) After **Move plate to the front** the moved plate lost its color and filament changes, pauses and custom G-code, and the other plates picked them up. Undo and redo had the same problem. Fixes #11287. | Before | After | |--------|-------| | | | * **Overhang speeds are measured against the layer below** by @valerii-bokhan in [16861](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/16861) With a height range modifier that turns **Slow down for overhangs** on, every wall of that range's first layer printed at bridge speed, vertical walls included. On a multi-nozzle printer with the setting off for one nozzle, overhang speed alternated from layer to layer. G-code changes only on the layers that were measured wrong. * **A 0.2 mm nozzle at 0.2 mm layers slices again** by @thelegendtubaguy in [17643](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17643) Slicing failed with "Line width too small" on the stock 0.20mm Standard presets for 0.2 mm nozzles on several Creality and LONGER printers. Bridges, overhang walls and support bottom interfaces printed without thick bridges now also get the flow their flow ratio asks for. Fixes #13685 and #11513. * **Arrange keeps objects clear of a compacted prime tower** by @Art-Porto in [17304](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17304) With **No sparse layers** on, Arrange and Fill bed placed objects hard against the prime tower and slicing then refused the plate, because the toolhead needs room beside the tower. Both now leave that room. Fixes #17566. | Before | After | |--------|-------| | | | ## Command Line * **The command line keeps every object when the bed size changes** by @raistlin7447 in [17897](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17897) Slicing one plate of a project for a printer with a different bed matched objects to plates on the old bed's layout, so an object near a plate edge joined the plate beside it and was left out of the G-code. Slicing for the printer the project was saved with is unchanged. Fixes #17741. ## Interface Fixes * **Ctrl and the wheel resize the Texture displacement brush** by @yw4z in [17926](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17926) — in **Texture displacement**, Ctrl and the mouse wheel change the brush size instead of zooming, and Cmd works on macOS as the tooltips say. * **Plate Settings follows the plate picked in the 3D view** by @anselor in [17838](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17838) — clicking a plate in the 3D view left **Plate Settings** on the previous plate until you clicked it in the object list too. * **IDEX and IQEX tools are numbered from 1 like the filaments** by @thelegendtubaguy in [16959](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/16959) Tool buttons, the filament picker and the messages that name a tool all counted from T0 while the sidebar numbered filaments from 1, so the same tool had two numbers. **Tool 0 Position** is now **Tool 1 Position**. Fixes #16832. * **A part's own feature filament counts on the plate** by @raistlin7447 in [17778](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17778) On a dual-nozzle printer, giving a part's outer wall or infill its own filament left that filament out of the **Filament grouping** list and hid the prime tower in Prepare, while the same setting on the whole object worked. Fixes #17728. | Before | After | |--------|-------| | | | * **The first right-click after a Shift pan works in Touchpad camera mode** by @Noisyfox in [17846](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17846) — with **Camera style** set to **Touchpad**, the first right-click after a Shift pan did nothing. Fixes #17844. * **A right-button pan or rotation keeps your selection** by @yw4z in [17432](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17432) — ending a right-button pan or rotation over an object no longer selects it and drops what you had picked. * **Shift-drag no longer starts a rectangle selection in Measure and Assemble** by @Noisyfox in [17533](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17533) — Shift-dragging in either gizmo started a selection box that could interrupt a measurement, while Shift still picks a point. * **A Thai interface shows Thai text** by @yw4z in [17818](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17818) With the interface language set to Thai, labels throughout OrcaSlicer drew as empty boxes on Linux unless the system had a Thai font installed, and a new text object in Text Emboss on Windows fell back to the English default text. The bundled Sarabun font now reaches both. | Before | After | |--------|-------| | | | * **Slice all no longer lists a mixed filament as its own spool** by @raistlin7447 in [17767](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17767) — on a dual-nozzle printer with custom filament grouping, the Slice all grouping dialog shows only physical filaments, as Slice plate does. Fixes #17712. * **The IP and access code dialog stays on screen at high display scaling** by @raistlin7447 in [17763](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17763) — at scaling around 300% the dialog opened with its title bar above the top of the screen and could not be dragged back. Fixes #17749. * **The G-code preview no longer shows a stray Pressure Advance value** by @yw4z in [17746](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17746) — G-code that sets no pressure advance showed an arbitrary number in the Pressure Advance view, which reads zero now. * **The cloud login dialog stays on screen and can be resized** by @rblumen in [17721](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/pull/17721) At 150% scaling on a 1080p screen the Orca Cloud and Bambu Cloud login dialog was taller than the work area with its title bar off screen, so it could be neither moved nor closed. It now fits the work area and can be resized.
